newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESS SHARE ISSUE OVERSUBSCRIBED 379 TIMES.
newsitem.headline: ESS SHARE ISSUE OVERSUBSCRIBED 379 TIMES.

text.p: A share issue for Estonian Security Service (ESS), one of the biggest security firms in Estonia, was oversubscribed by 379 times, Hoiupank Investments said on Friday.
ESS issued 176,000 new shares and investors placed orders for 66.6 million shares, Mart Magi, the chairman of Hoiupank Investments, told Reuters.
In total, 720 investors participated in the issue, Magi said. The investors were both private and institutional and included many foreigners, he added.
The shares will be distributed proportionally among the subscribers, Magi said. Investors who subscribed for under 380 shares will not get anything, he said.
Hoiupank Investments will provide a prospectus to list its shares on the Tallinn stock exchange after May 5, Magi said.
As only 15 percent of its shares are publicly traded, the shares must go to the bourse's free market at first, he added.
The Tallinn stock echange's official list requires that 25 percent of a company's shares be traded publicly.
ESS issued 176,000 new shares in a public offer to expand its share capital to 1.176 million shares or 11.76 million kroons.
The price of a 10-kroon face value share was 57 kroons.
The company has forecast a profit of 11.5 million kroons for 1997 and its 1996 profit was 3.9 kroons. The company recently expanded its activities to Latvia.
